slides.title: Holiday guests are coming. Start with the room you hide things in.
Name what's in there
slides.body: Walk in with a notepad. Write the 5 biggest piles. Now it's a list, not a monster.

slides.title: Do one pile a day
slides.body: Five piles, five days, 15 minutes each. The room is ready before anyone books a flight.

slides.title: The 'decide later' box
slides.body: Things you can't decide on go into one labeled box with a date. Out of the guest's way, still yours.

slides.title: The guest room doesn't need to be perfect. It needs a bed you can see.
Get the guest prep checklist
slides.body: The Tidy Brain Printable Pack has a holiday guest checklist and a 5-day room tracker. Link in bio.
